hypothesis: Fixed lr0.001 may contribute to late optimization regressions; not established
scope: training-only diagnostic, all twelve classes; no test/validation access
optimizer: fresh PyTorch Adam eps1e-8, no scheduler or clipping
comparison: same full-batch permutations and initialization, same 400 updates and 48000 examples processed per case; only learning rate differs
stopping: fixed horizon, no early stopping; final state is primary, intermediate minima are descriptive
measurements: final minus best loss and accuracy
decision: If lower lr reduces regressions but has worse final loss, insufficient evidence of a better optimization recipe. If both fail to memorize, investigate activations and conditioning before increasing dataset size. A successful memorization run does not establish generalization.
limitations: different learning rates imply different effective optimization speed
